rationale: Build on the current recurrent-tail baseline with a compact structural change: keep reverse-tail recurrence and the existing gain curriculum, but partially refresh the decoder-output anchor after the deepest replay using the next block's staged gain. This stays compile-stable, adds no new learned tensors, and targets the locally promising anchor-refresh family without another scalar-only sweep.
title: Staged Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Carryover
